description: Delegate file analysis to the Antigravity CLI (Gemini) instead of reading files yourself. USE THIS whenever a file is large (>200 lines) or the task spans more than 3 files: logs, database dumps, generated code, cross-file reviews, comparisons. The files never enter your context — only the answer does.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the working directory / project root. Defaults to the server's cwd.

files.description: File paths to analyze (relative to cwd or absolute).

model.description: Override the model: a name or id from `agy models`, or a `*` version pattern such as "Gemini * Pro (High)". Normally omit — the tool routes automatically.

question.description: What you want to know about these files.

name: analyze_files
